Live page v9: league-grouped folding cards, drawn bracket, seeds, wins, odds over time, road tiles, expert bars

Dom (Nov 5): four meters on top as the summary, everything else inside each league's card, most
sections fold, Rooting Guide dropped, richer charts back. Page-wide boards removed; each card now
has This week (today's ride, score range, on the line, who's left), Recommendations (with moves),
Alerts, Playoff picture (bracket rings, seed bars, wins histogram, race), Season odds (area chart,
road tiles, next up, byes), Experts (bar chart per starter, accuracy bars), weather, clear.
